method: Separate read-only projection of actual run timestamps and usage. Sorted linear quantile at (n-1)*p; throughput is completed count / rounded reported duration. Comparison tolerance .0011 covers original rounding.
reviewer: Builder assistant arithmetic check; not independent human validation
limitations: Submission median is runner-reported; original per-submission client timing samples are not retained and are not independently recomputed here.
Finite local extractive workload, not public capacity or an SLA.
